import hashlib, math
from pathlib import Path
from oscillator import solve
root=Path('C:/Users/Administrator/source/agent-team-skill/.agent-team/04d3e750cd60458a9671f93e05e2e909')
assert hashlib.sha256((root/'design-v1.md').read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a4004d1d22ebd3c55af012fb7e10f9982c8f79ac249f2cb928d1e1575c8be441'
assert solve(.1,0) == [(0.,1.,0.)]
assert len(solve(.1,1)) == 2
_,x,v=solve(.1,1)[-1]
assert abs(x-.995) <= 1e-14 and abs(v+.09975) <= 1e-14
short=solve(.1,100)
assert len(short)==101
assert all(t==n*.1 for n,(t,_,_) in enumerate(short))
ex=max(abs(x-math.cos(t)) for t,x,v in short)
ev=max(abs(v+math.sin(t)) for t,x,v in short)
assert ex < .01 and ev < .01
print('analytic_max_x_v_error',ex,ev)
h=.1
long=solve(h,20000)
assert len(long)==20001 and long[-1][0]==2000
energies=[(x*x+v*v)/2 for _,x,v in long]
q0=1-h*h/4
qdrift=max(abs(v*v+q0*x*x-q0) for _,x,v in long)
assert min(energies) >= .5-h*h/8-1e-10 and max(energies) <= .5+1e-10
assert qdrift < 1e-10
print('energy_min_max',min(energies),max(energies),'modified_invariant_max_drift',qdrift)
errors=[]
for h,n in [(.2,50),(.1,100),(.05,200)]:
    t,x,v=solve(h,n)[-1]
    assert t==10
    errors.append(math.hypot(x-math.cos(t),v+math.sin(t)))
assert errors[0]>errors[1]>errors[2]>0
ratios=[errors[i]/errors[i+1] for i in range(2)]
assert all(3.5<=r<=4.5 for r in ratios)
print('endpoint_errors',errors,'ratios',ratios,'observed_orders',[math.log2(r) for r in ratios])
# Independent closed-form discrete solution covers additional stable step sizes.
for h,n in [(.05,400),(.2,100),(1.,100),(1.9,100)]:
    theta=2*math.asin(h/2)
    states=solve(h,n)
    discrete_error=max(max(abs(x-math.cos(k*theta)),abs(v+math.sqrt(1-h*h/4)*math.sin(k*theta))) for k,(_,x,v) in enumerate(states))
    assert discrete_error < 1e-10
    print('discrete_benchmark',h,n,'max_state_error',discrete_error)
